description: Production-quality Arnold lighting for cinematic FX shots — key/rim separation, volumetric scatter, atmospheric depth.

orchestration_stages.label: Sky / HDRI Base
orchestration_stages.description: Establish base environmental lighting from sky or HDRI.
orchestration_hints: Use Arnold SkyDomeLightNode if HDRI available.
Otherwise use procedural sky (ai_physical_sky).
Intensity 0.3–0.8 for explosion context — not overpowering.
artistic_constraints: Sky exposure must not overpower hero FX lighting.
HDRI rotation must match sun direction.

orchestration_stages.label: Key Light
orchestration_stages.description: Primary cinematic key light — warm side fill from explosion direction.
orchestration_hints: Directional or area light at 30–60 degree elevation.
Color temperature: 3200–4500K (warm orange for explosion context).
Intensity: 4.0–8.0 relative to fill.
artistic_constraints: Must come from the direction of the explosion source.
Shadow must be ray-traced — no shadow maps.

orchestration_stages.label: Rim Light
orchestration_stages.description: Back rim light to separate hero elements from background.
orchestration_hints: Opposite side from key — 160–200 degree from key.
Color: cool blue/white (6000–8000K).
Intensity: 1.5–3.0. Strong enough to create visible rim.
artistic_constraints: Rim must be visible on hero FX element silhouette.
Light linking — rim hits FX only, not terrain.

orchestration_stages.label: Fill Light
orchestration_stages.description: Soft ambient fill to recover shadow detail without destroying contrast.
orchestration_hints: Large soft source — area light or dome contribution.
Intensity 0.5–1.5 (1/4 to 1/6 of key).
Color: desaturated neutral.
artistic_constraints: Fill must preserve shadow contrast — not fill shadows to black.
No fill specular contribution — avoid flat look.

orchestration_stages.label: Volumetric Atmosphere
orchestration_stages.description: Add volumetric scatter to atmosphere — air feels thick and cinematic.
orchestration_hints: Arnold atmosphere shader or Houdini atmosphere volume.
Density: 0.05–0.15 (light scatter, not fog).
Enabled only on directional lights — not fill.
artistic_constraints: Volumetric must be present — flat atmosphere not acceptable.
Scatter must contribute to color — warm in key direction.

orchestration_stages.label: Shadow Control
orchestration_stages.description: Configure shadow properties for cinematic feel.
orchestration_hints: Shadow density: 0.85–0.95 — not pure black.
Light radius/angle drives softness.
Large source = soft penumbra on organic elements.
artistic_constraints: No hard-edge shadows on smoke or debris.
Ground shadows must have visible penumbra.

orchestration_stages.label: Exposure Balance
orchestration_stages.description: Set final exposure — highlights hold detail, shadows readable.
orchestration_hints: Arnold exposure in camera node or render settings.
Target: fireball luminance near 1.0–2.0 (allow bloom).
Ground: 0.1–0.3.
artistic_constraints: Fireball may blow out slightly — expected.
Ground must not be pure black.
No clipping in AOV passes — use exposure, not gamma.

review_expectations.contrast: Clear key/fill separation. Not flat ambient lighting.
review_expectations.rim: Rim light visible on hero FX silhouette.
review_expectations.volumetric: Atmosphere scatter visible — air feels thick.
review_expectations.shadows: Penumbra on organic elements. Ground shadows readable.
review_expectations.exposure: Highlights hold some detail. Shadows not pure black.
review_expectations.color: Warm key, cool rim. Color temperature separation.
